name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Design submissions need a mandatory 24-hour manual review by the Creative Director before any AI generation starts. This catches tone mismatches and branding errors early, saving rework. The trade-off is slower launch times, but quality control beats speed here.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk is that the Creative Director becomes the single point of failure—every submission stalls waiting for their review, which delays AI generation and creates a backlog. Instead, let Marketing and Design co-own a shared style guide artifact that AI generation can reference automatically, cutting manual review to edge cases only. Settle it by testing the guide’s accuracy on 10 recent submissions—if it catches 90% of errors, adopt it.
